map.intro: Each notion is coloured by the average of your last 3 scores (Feynman mode and quizzes).
map.nextIntro: Your weakest notions, with the pages to re-read.
map.nextEmpty: Nothing to review yet. Explain a notion or take a quiz: your weak spots will show up here.
map.chartIntro: Practised notions, weakest first. Review below 3, mastered from 4.
map.degraded: Scores are unavailable right now (the mastery service is offline). You can still ask questions.
map.noNotions: This course has no notions yet. Run this command, then review the drafted file:

study.title: Ask the book
study.lede: Every answer is checked against the pages it cites before you see it.
study.emptyTitle: What do you want to understand?
study.emptyText: Ask anything about this course ({scope}). Answers cite the pages they come from; click one to read it.
study.quizMe: Quiz me on my weak spots
study.shortcut: Press / to ask, Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
study.noNotions: This course has no notions yet
study.degraded: Limited mode: the mastery service is offline
study.error: StudyMate can't answer right now. The free Gemini quota may be busy: try again in a minute.

reader.title: Book
reader.emptyText: Click a page number in an answer: the page opens with the cited passage highlighted.
reader.error: The PDF can't be shown here. Open it in a new tab.

feynman.title: Feynman mode
feynman.lede: Explain a notion in your own words, as if to a friend. Each key idea is checked; the score is computed by code.
feynman.placeholder: Explain it simply, in your own words…
feynman.resultEmpty: Write your explanation, then check it: the key ideas you covered and missed will appear here.
feynman.notRecorded: Score not saved: the mastery service is offline.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.lede: Questions on the notions due for review, then your weakest ones, written from the book's pages and graded by code.
quiz.question: Question {index} of {total}
quiz.keys: Keys 1–4 to answer, P to skip, Enter for the next question
quiz.notRecorded: Scores not saved: the mastery service is offline.
quiz.empty: No questions could be written this time. Try again.
quiz.degraded: The mastery service is offline: notions were picked at random.
quiz.skippedHint: Not graded: your progress does not change. Re-read these pages.
quiz.noneAnswered: No question answered: nothing was recorded.

library.title: Library
library.lede: Each course is a public textbook: its PDF, the passages indexed for search, its notions and your progress.
library.addIntro: Any textbook you are allowed to reuse works, for example an OpenStax book. Its text is sent to Gemini to draft the notions, so never add private documents.
library.add1: Describe the course in course/courses.json: id, title, PDF link, license, chapters (or a page range).
library.add2: Run one command: it downloads the PDF, indexes the pages and drafts the notions.
library.add3: Review course/notions/<id>.json, set "validated" to true, then restart the API.
library.uploadIntro: Drop the PDF, choose the chapters to study: StudyMate indexes the pages and drafts the notions. Only documents you may reuse: their text is sent to Gemini, so never add personal data.
library.drop: Drop a PDF here, or choose a file
library.found: {pages} pages · {chapters} chapters found in the outline
library.noChapters: No “Chapter N” entries in the outline: choose a page range.
library.rights: I may use this document, and it contains no personal data.
library.readyText: The course is ready. Its notions are an AI draft: review them before relying on them.
library.confirmDelete: Delete this course, its passages and its notions? Scores already recorded stay in the mastery service.
library.uploadError: This PDF could not be read.

footer.license: Code: MIT. Course content: see each book's license.

demo.banner: Public demo: these answers were computed in advance with the real pipeline. No AI call is made here, and your scores stay in this browser.
demo.onlyExamples: The public demo only answers its example questions: pick one below, or ask for a quiz or a revision plan. Install StudyMate locally to ask anything.
demo.feynmanOnly: The public demo only grades its example explanations: choose one above. Install StudyMate locally to have any explanation graded.
demo.reader: The demo has no local copy of the book: open this page on openstax.org with the button above. The cited passage is quoted here.
demo.library: The public demo is read-only: install StudyMate locally to upload a textbook.

reviews.title: Next reviews
reviews.intro: Spaced repetition (FSRS): each notion comes back just before you would forget it, based on your scores.
reviews.empty: No review scheduled yet: explain a notion or take a quiz to start.

gesture.title: Answer with your hand
gesture.error: Camera unavailable: use the keys 1–4 and P.
gesture.privacy: Off by default. When on, your hand is detected in this browser: no image is sent or stored. The detection model is downloaded once from Google.
gesture.help: 1 to 4 raised fingers = answer 1 to 4 (thumb ignored) · fist for 1.5 s = skip · hold still 1 s · remove your hand or press Escape to cancel.
gesture.nextHelp: Change or remove your hand, then show your open hand to go on.

account.title: Your account
account.lede: An account keeps your scores, review dates and goals. The password is stored as a hash only.
account.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
account.taken: This email already has an account: sign in instead.
account.invalid: Check the email and use 8 to 72 characters for the password.
account.down: The account service is unavailable. Try again in a moment.
account.notSaved: Not saved: sign in to keep your progress.
account.progress: Sign in to save your scores and see your progress, review dates and plan.
